suites.name: trust-plumbing
suites.detail: depends on github.com/mitstack-eu/operator-kit at or above the floor v0.1.0, kitshim.go present, no kit-owned symbol redeclared, manifest.yaml present

suites.name: contract
suites.detail: TestContract_* accepts every valid golden and rejects the malformed ones

suites.name: secret-safety
suites.detail: TestNoSecretLeak (+ the /logs variant where /logs is served) passes

suites.name: teardown
suites.detail: TestUnsubscribeDeletes* proves unsubscribe deletes what subscribe created

suites.name: deliverable
suites.detail: own Dockerfile exists and assumes no monorepo build context

suites.name: manifest
suites.detail: spec.outputs and spec.requires[].reads resolve through the resource registry; no --base-manifest given, so spec.version was not compared

suites.name: naming
suites.detail: manifest.yaml declares no spec.naming.appName, so there is no app-name limit to check

suites.name: capability-parity
suites.detail: capability-parity compares multiple providers of one capability — not meaningful for a single standalone target
